21.YLT: The kindnesses of Jehovah! For we have not been consumed, For not ended have His mercies. New every morning, abundant is thy faithfulness.

22.KJV: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the Lord require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
22.YLT: He hath declared to thee, O man, what is good; Yea, what is Jehovah requiring of thee, Except--to do judgment, and love kindness, And lowly to walk with thy God?

23.KJV: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
23.YLT: so let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works, and may glorify your Father who is in the heavens.

24.KJV: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
24.YLT: but seek ye first the reign of God and His righteousness, and all these shall be added to you.

25.KJV: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
25.YLT: `Come unto me, all ye labouring and burdened ones, and I will give you rest,

26.KJV: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
26.YLT: for even the Son of Man came not to be ministered to, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.'

27.KJV: For with God nothing shall be impossible.
27.YLT: because nothing shall be impossible with God.'

28.KJV: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
28.YLT: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God;

29.KJV: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
29.YLT: for God did so love the world, that His Son--the only begotten--He gave, that every one who is believing in him may not perish, but may have life age-during.

30.KJV: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
30.YLT: Again, therefore, Jesus spake to them, saying, `I am the light of the world; he who is following me shall not walk in the darkness, but he shall have the light of the life.'

31.KJV: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
31.YLT: Jesus saith to him, `I am the way, and the truth, and the life, no one doth come unto the Father, if not through me;

32.KJV: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
32.YLT: and God doth commend His own love to us, that, in our being still sinners, Christ did die for us;

33.KJV: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
33.YLT: And we have known that to those loving God all things do work together for good, to those who are called according to purpose;

34.KJV: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
34.YLT: and be not conformed to this age, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, for your proving what is the will of God--the good, and acceptable, and perfect.

35.KJV: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
35.YLT: and now there doth remain faith, hope, love--these three; and the greatest of these is love.

36.KJV: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
36.YLT: so that if any one is in Christ-- he is a new creature; the old things did pass away, lo, become new have the all things.

37.KJV: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
37.YLT: with Christ I have been crucified, and live no more do I, and Christ doth live in me; and that which I now live in the flesh--in the faith I live of the Son of God, who did love me and did give himself for me;

38.KJV: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
38.YLT: And the fruit of the Spirit is: Love, joy, peace, long-suffering, kindness, goodness, faith,

39.KJV: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:
39.YLT: for by grace ye are having been saved, through faith, and this not of you--of God the gift,

40.KJV: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
40.YLT: for nothing be anxious, but in everything by prayer, and by supplication, with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known unto God; and the peace of God, that is surpassing all understanding, shall guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

41.KJV: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
41.YLT: For all things I have strength, in Christ's strengthening me;

42.KJV: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
42.YLT: and all, whatever ye may do--out of soul work--as to the Lord, and not to men,

43.KJV: Rejoice evermore. Pray without ceasing. In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
43.YLT: always rejoice ye; continually pray ye; in every thing give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus in regard to you.

44.KJV: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
44.YLT: for God did not give us a spirit of fear, but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind;

45.KJV: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
45.YLT: for the reckoning of God is living, and working, and sharp above every two-edged sword, and piercing unto the dividing asunder both of soul and spirit, of joints also and marrow, and a discerner of thoughts and intents of the heart;

46.KJV: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
46.YLT: And faith is of things hoped for a confidence, of matters not seen a conviction,

47.KJV: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
47.YLT: looking to the author and perfecter of faith--Jesus, who, over-against the joy set before him--did endure a cross, shame having despised, on the right hand also of the throne of God did sit down;

48.KJV: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
48.YLT: and if any of you do lack wisdom, let him ask from God, who is giving to all liberally, and not reproaching, and it shall be given to him;

49.KJV: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
49.YLT: all your care having cast upon Him, because He careth for you.

50.KJV: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
50.YLT: if we may confess our sins, stedfast He is and righteous that He may forgive us the sins, and may cleanse us from every unrighteousness;

51.KJV: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
51.YLT: he who is not loving did not know God, because God is love.

52.KJV: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
52.YLT: lo, I have stood at the door, and I knock; if any one may hear my voice, and may open the door, I will come in unto him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

53.KJV: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.
53.YLT: and God shall wipe away every tear from their eyes, and the death shall not be any more, nor sorrow, nor crying, nor shall there be any more pain, because the first things did go away.'

54.KJV: The Lord bless thee, and keep thee: The Lord make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee: The Lord lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
54.YLT: `Jehovah bless thee and keep thee; `Jehovah cause His face to shine upon thee, and favour thee; `Jehovah lift up His countenance upon thee, and appoint for thee--peace.

55.KJV: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the Lord thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
55.YLT: be strong and courageous, fear not, nor be terrified because of them, for Jehovah thy God is He who is going with thee; He doth not fail thee nor forsake thee.'

56.KJV: Seek the Lord and his strength, seek his face continually.
56.YLT: Seek ye Jehovah and His strength, Seek His face continually.

57.KJV: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the Lord is your strength.
57.YLT: And he saith to them, `Go, eat fat things, and drink sweet things, and sent portions to him for whom nothing is prepared, for to-day is holy to our Lord, and be not grieved, for the joy of Jehovah is your strength.'

58.KJV: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:
58.YLT: That--I have known my Redeemer, The Living and the Last, For the dust he doth rise.

59.KJV: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful. But his delight is in the law of the Lord; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
59.YLT: O the happiness of that one, who Hath not walked in the counsel of the wicked. And in the way of sinners hath not stood, And in the seat of scorners hath not sat; But--in the law of Jehovah is his delight, And in His law he doth meditate by day and by night:

60.KJV: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
60.YLT: Thou causest me to know the path of life; Fulness of joys is with Thy presence, Pleasant things by Thy right hand for ever!

61.KJV: Delight thyself also in the Lord; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
61.YLT: And delight thyself on Jehovah, And He giveth to thee the petitions of thy heart.

62.KJV: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
62.YLT: To number our days aright let us know, And we bring the heart to wisdom.

63.KJV: A Psalm of David. Bless the Lord, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name. Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
63.YLT: By David. Bless, O my soul, Jehovah, And all my inward parts--His Holy Name. Bless, O my soul, Jehovah, And forget not all His benefits,

64.KJV: A Song of degrees. I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help. My help cometh from the Lord, which made heaven and earth.
64.YLT: A Song of the Ascents. I lift up mine eyes unto the hills, Whence doth my help come? My help is from Jehovah, maker of heaven and earth,

65.KJV: A Song of degrees for Solomon. Except the Lord build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the Lord keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.
65.YLT: A Song of the Ascents, by Solomon. If Jehovah doth not build the house, In vain have its builders laboured at it, If Jehovah doth not watch a city, In vain hath a watchman waked.

66.KJV: The Lord is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
66.YLT: Near is Jehovah to all those calling Him, To all who call Him in truth.

67.KJV: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
67.YLT: A soft answer turneth back fury, And a grievous word raiseth up anger.

68.KJV: Commit thy works unto the Lord, and thy thoughts shall be established.
68.YLT: Roll unto Jehovah thy works, And established are thy purposes,

69.KJV: The name of the Lord is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
69.YLT: A tower of strength is the name of Jehovah, Into it the righteous runneth, and is set on high.

70.KJV: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
70.YLT: Give instruction to a youth about his way, Even when he is old he turneth not from it.

71.KJV: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:
71.YLT: To everything--a season, and a time to every delight under the heavens:

72.KJV: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.
72.YLT: And I hear the voice of the Lord, saying: `Whom do I send? and who doth go for Us?' And I say, `Here am I, send me.'

73.KJV: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
73.YLT: An imagination supported Thou fortifiest peace--peace! For in Thee it is confident.

74.KJV: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
74.YLT: And he is pierced for our transgressions, Bruised for our iniquities, The chastisement of our peace is on him, And by his bruise there is healing to us.

75.KJV: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the Lord. For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
75.YLT: For not My thoughts are your thoughts, Nor your ways My ways, --an affirmation of Jehovah, For high have the heavens been above the earth, So high have been My ways above your ways, And My thoughts above your thoughts.

76.KJV: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
76.YLT: Call unto Me, and I do answer thee, yea, I declare to thee great and fenced things--thou hast not known them.

77.KJV: If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of thine hand, O king.
77.YLT: Lo, it is; our God whom we are serving, is able to deliver us from a burning fiery furnace; and from thy hand, O king, He doth deliver.

78.KJV: The Lord thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.
78.YLT: Jehovah thy God is in thy midst, A mighty one doth save, He rejoiceth over thee with joy, He doth work in His love, He joyeth over thee with singing.'

79.KJV: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, saith the Lord of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.
79.YLT: Bring in all the tithe unto the treasure-house, And there is food in My house; When ye have tried Me, now, with this, Said Jehovah of Hosts, Do not I open to you the windows of heaven? Yea, I have emptied on you a blessing till there is no space.

80.KJV: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
80.YLT: But he answering said, `It hath been written, Not upon bread alone doth man live, but upon every word coming forth from the mouth of God.'

81.KJV: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
81.YLT: `Ye are the light of the world, a city set upon a mount is not able to be hid;

82.KJV: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
82.YLT: `Ask, and it shall be given to you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened to you;

83.KJV: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind. This is the first and great commandment. And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
83.YLT: And Jesus said to him, `Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thine understanding-- this is a first and great command; and the second is like to it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself;

84.KJV: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
84.YLT: having gone, then, disciple all the nations, (baptizing them--to the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, teaching them to observe all, whatever I did command you,) and lo, I am with you all the days--till the full end of the age.'

85.KJV: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
85.YLT: `Give, and it shall be given to you; good measure, pressed, and shaken, and running over, they shall give into your bosom; for with that measure with which ye measure, it shall be measured to you again.'

86.KJV: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
86.YLT: `The thief doth not come, except that he may steal, and kill, and destroy; I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

87.KJV: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
87.YLT: Jesus said to her, `I am the rising again, and the life; he who is believing in me, even if he may die, shall live;

88.KJV: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
88.YLT: `I am the vine, ye the branches; he who is remaining in me, and I in him, this one doth bear much fruit, because apart from me ye are not able to do anything;

89.KJV: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
89.YLT: these things I have spoken to you, that in me ye may have peace, in the world ye shall have tribulation, but take courage--I have overcome the world.'

90.KJV: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
90.YLT: but ye shall receive power at the coming of the Holy Spirit upon you, and ye shall be witnesses to me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judea, and Samaria, and unto the end of the earth.'

91.KJV: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.
91.YLT: and there is not salvation in any other, for there is no other name under the heaven that hath been given among men, in which it behoveth us to be saved.'

92.KJV: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
92.YLT: for the wages of the sin is death, and the gift of God is life age-during in Christ Jesus our Lord.

93.KJV: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
93.YLT: that if thou mayest confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and mayest believe in thy heart that God did raise him out of the dead, thou shalt be saved,

94.KJV: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
94.YLT: and the God of the hope shall fill you with all joy and peace in the believing, for your abounding in the hope in power of the Holy Spirit.

95.KJV: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.
95.YLT: No temptation hath taken you--except human; and God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above what ye are able, but He will make, with the temptation, also the outlet, for your being able to bear it.

96.KJV: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
96.YLT: and to God--thanks, to Him who is giving us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ;

97.KJV: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
97.YLT: we not looking to the things seen, but to the things not seen; for the things seen are temporary, but the things not seen are age-during.

98.KJV: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
98.YLT: and He said to me, `Sufficient for thee is My grace, for My power in infirmity is perfected;' most gladly, therefore, will I rather boast in my infirmities, that the power of the Christ may rest on me:

99.KJV: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
99.YLT: and in the doing good we may not be faint-hearted, for at the proper time we shall reap--not desponding;

100.KJV: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
100.YLT: and to Him who is able above all things to do exceeding abundantly what we ask or think, according to the power that is working in us,

101.KJV: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.
101.YLT: and become one to another kind, tender-hearted, forgiving one another, according as also God in Christ did forgive you.

102.KJV: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might. Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
102.YLT: As to the rest, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might; put on the whole armour of God, for your being able to stand against the wiles of the devil,

103.KJV: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
103.YLT: having been confident of this very thing, that He who did begin in you a good work, will perform it till a day of Jesus Christ,

104.KJV: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
104.YLT: As to the rest, brethren, as many things as are true, as many as are grave, as many as are righteous, as many as are pure, as many as are lovely, as many as are of good report, if any worthiness, and if any praise, these things think upon;

105.KJV: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.
105.YLT: the things above mind ye, not the things upon the earth,

106.KJV: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
106.YLT: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly, in all wisdom, teaching and admonishing each other, in psalms, and hymns, and spiritual songs, in grace singing in your hearts to the Lord;

107.KJV: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.
107.YLT: stedfast is He who is calling you, who also will do it.

108.KJV: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.
108.YLT: and stedfast is the Lord, who shall establish you, and shall guard you from the evil;

109.KJV: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
109.YLT: every Writing is God-breathed, and profitable for teaching, for conviction, for setting aright, for instruction that is in righteousness,

110.KJV: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee. So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
110.YLT: Without covetousness the behaviour, being content with the things present, for He hath said, `No, I will not leave, no, nor forsake thee,' so that we do boldly say, `The Lord is to me a helper, and I will not fear what man shall do to me.'

111.KJV: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
111.YLT: Jesus Christ yesterday and to-day the same, and to the ages;

112.KJV: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.
112.YLT: draw nigh to God, and He will draw nigh to you; cleanse hands, ye sinners! and purify hearts, ye two-souled!

113.KJV: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
113.YLT: Be confessing to one another the trespasses, and be praying for one another, that ye may be healed; very strong is a working supplication of a righteous man;

114.KJV: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
114.YLT: and ye are a choice race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people acquired, that the excellences ye may shew forth of Him who out of darkness did call you to His wondrous light;

115.KJV: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
115.YLT: and the Lord God sanctify in your hearts. And be ready always for defence to every one who is asking of you an account concerning the hope that is in you, with meekness and fear;

116.KJV: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.
116.YLT: and, before all things, to one another having the earnest love, because the love shall cover a multitude of sins;

117.KJV: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
117.YLT: the Lord is not slow in regard to the promise, as certain count slowness, but is long-suffering to us, not counselling any to be lost but all to pass on to reformation,

118.KJV: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
118.YLT: See ye what love the Father hath given to us, that children of God we may be called; because of this the world doth not know us, because it did not know Him;

119.KJV: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:
119.YLT: And this is the boldness that we have toward Him, that if anything we may ask according to his will, He doth hear us,
